result.pairwise_reason: Q010-B and Q010-A are nearly equivalent in quality, but Q010-B adds miR-375-3p/LRP5 evidence (PMID:28158288), circRNA context, and explicitly addresses cross-species plant exosome miRNA questions, providing marginally broader mechanistic coverage with clearer evidence-gap acknowledgment.
